# Photography credits and usage

Retrieved 31 October 2026. These stock images illustrate vehicle care; they are not photographs of Tecur's staff, premises, inventory, or completed work. Do not represent pictured people as Tecur employees or imply Toyota manufacturer endorsement. Tecur should replace workshop imagery with its own commissioned photographs when available.

All four originals are marked **Free to use under the Unsplash License** on the corresponding photo page. The license permits free commercial and noncommercial copyright use, modification and distribution, subject to its terms: https://unsplash.com/license. These are freely licensed stock photographs, not public-domain or open-source software assets. Trademarks and identifiable people's rights are separate from the photo copyright license: https://unsplash.com/terms.
